facts.value: An earlier successful item-transition helper returns true immediately. Otherwise, either failed tether eligibility check returns false without decrementing the counter. After both gates pass, held L/R and nonzero mv.co.common.x0 enter CatchDash and return true; otherwise a nonzero counter is decremented and the function returns false. Zero remains zero within this function, but a separate AttackDash setter can write the window from p_ftCommonData->x68.
facts.rationale: Replaces the unsupported claim of permanent expiration and makes the decrement's control-flow scope explicit.

evidence.why: Defines every return and the conditional decrement.
Shows window initialization, the separate setter and the IASA caller.
